title: semantic bug when verifying certificate file
root_cause: Newer OpenSSL versions do not support zero serial numbers, which is non-conforming with RFC 5280.
notes: This is a candidate C harness translated from a CLI PoC. It requires the original input certificate as inputs/poc.pem.
validation_notes: Translated from CLI command `openssl x509 -in $PoC -text -noout`. The generated C harness compiled and executed successfully using a system certificate copied to inputs/poc.pem. Valgrind reported 0 errors. This validates the harness structure, but does not strictly reproduce the original issue because the original PoC certificate has not been recovered.
